CHEMISTRY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHEMISTRY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Industrial manufacture of inorganic chemicals ● Ammonia - The Haber Process. (ra? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Industrial manufacture of inorganic chemicals ● Ammonia - The Haber Process. (ra.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Industrial manufacture of inorganic chemicals ● Ammonia - The Haber Process. (ra.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Industrial manufacture of inorganic chemicals ● Ammonia - The Haber Process. (ra.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Industrial manufacture of inorganic chemicals ● Ammonia - The Haber Process. (ra.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.0: INORGANIC CHEMISTRY Strand S? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.0: INORGANIC CHEMISTRY Strand S.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.0: INORGANIC CHEMISTRY Strand S.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.0: INORGANIC CHEMISTRY Strand S.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.0: INORGANIC CHEMISTRY Strand S.

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Electrochemistry ● Redox reactions ● Electrochemical cell ● Standard electrode p and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
